title: Who will win?
html_source:
The Jesuits encouraged competition as a teaching strategy.

Section 296 of the Ratio Studiorum:

In the second hour of the morning, the last lesson should be reviewed briefly, and a new one should be taught for half an hour or for a little more. Right away the students should be asked to repeat it, and, if there is any time left, they should compete with each other on it.
